title.narrative: Firm-level demonstration of technologies and productivity enhancement for the pulp and paper industry

description.narrative: As of today, the Indian paper industry is unable to meet the growing market demands due to low productivity, which in turn is the result of several challenges such as weak pace of innovation, scarce availability of raw materials, high cost of basic inputs, low economies of scale and use of outdated technology in a majority of firms. There is thus a latent but urgent need to technologically upgrade Indian paper mills to improve their productivity and sustainability. In order to address the aforementioned, on 31 March 2018, UNIDO, with the aid of the International Centre for Inclusive and Sustainable Industrial Development, operationally completed the project #Development and adoption of appropriate technologies for enhancing productivity in the paper and pulp sector# (SAP ID: 150282. #Phase-1 Project). The project#s independent terminal evaluation confirmed that the project had strengthened management and technological capacity and capability of the nodal technical institution for the Indian paper and pulp industry, respectively the Central Pulp and Paper Research Institute (CPPRI) and select industry associations. These are now in better position to provide technical and management support to the Indian pulp and paper industry.
